availability: Archive timestamp_received retained as reported; live durable available_at rounded upward to milliseconds; never backdate
current_quote: Latest exchange-source timestamp among observations already available at decision; source<=availability<=decision and source age<=120s
event_process: Direct price_change BBO only; book/trade/tick do not define quotes
identity: Known condition and YES asset mapping; NO filtered; unknown identity/schema rejected
lags: 5/15/30 minutes as of each own clock, zero delta plus missing flag when unavailable
operational_gate: Separate from features: connected stream, pong<=35s, 30m warmup since connect/known interruption; fresh metadata and unresolved status; expiry>t+30m
price_precision: Decimal four places; truncate toward zero; invalid values become invalid zero quotes
quality: 0<bid<=ask<1 and spread<=0.05+1e-12; invalid newest source quote has no older-quote fallback
remaining_limits: Different quote process; old model and performance do not transfer
Two live contracts do not establish broad coverage
target_status: Not built/scored here. New model protocol must freeze current/endpoint measurement and missing endpoint rules before evaluation.
ties: Same-source identical BBO values collapse; conflicting BBO values abstain
